name: ci-watch
description: Checks GitHub Actions every 90 s (for up to 3 h) for new failed runs on the current branch and reports the run ID

name: plan-watch
description: Checks the live plan page's reviewer event log (events.jsonl of the newest plan under .workspace/local/plans/) every 2 s for up to 3 h and prints each new event as one plan-event line; stops when the plan is approved or rejected
